title: Karavan Portal
shortDescription: Wholesale grocery ordering for Karavan Imports retail partners.
fullDescription:
Karavan Portal is the official wholesale ordering app for Karavan Imports, an importer of authentic grocery products from the Middle East, Northern Africa, and South Asia.

Built for retailers, grocers, and food-service businesses, Karavan Portal puts our full catalog in your pocket so you can restock quickly from anywhere.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Browse 1,000+ SKUs sourced from 15+ countries
• Place wholesale orders with per-SKU minimums
• View and download invoices
• Track order history and shipments
• Contact our support team directly

HOW IT WORKS
Karavan Portal is for approved wholesale buyers. New businesses can apply for a wholesale account right in the app — once approved, sign in with your buyer email and password to start ordering.

Orders are processed within 48 hours and typically ship in 5–12 business days.

Questions? Reach us at support@karavanimports.com.
